definitions.durations: milliseconds; UI is FrameTiming.buildDuration; raster is FrameTiming.rasterDuration
definitions.coverage: Flutter engine frame timings only; embedded WebView compositor and video frames are not measured; no screen-present FPS or actual display-present dropped-frame measurement is provided
definitions.overBudgetFrames: duration > 1000 / refreshRateHz, separately per thread; union counts a frame once when either thread exceeds budget
definitions.estimatedMissedVsyncs: sum(max(0, ceil(max(buildUs, rasterUs) / (1000000 / refreshRateHz)) - 1)); throughput estimate, not measured display-present drops
definitions.percentiles: nearest rank, logarithmic histogram upper bound capped at observed maximum; error <= 6.25% of duration or 1 microsecond; averages and worst frames are exact
definitions.attribution: labels start on next scheduler frame; PlatformDispatcher.frameData.frameNumber matches FrameTiming.frameNumber; delayed batches use retained frame-key history, not callback time or presentation timestamps
definitions.unattributed: frames without retained label history are counted and excluded from duration/budget statistics rather than guessed
definitions.lifecycle: only resumed state is collected; engine batches pending at stop/pause may not be delivered; pre-reset frames are excluded
definitions.refreshRate: per-frame label rate; initial 60 Hz is an assumption until the app supplies a display rate
definitions.scenarios: one explicit scenario at a time; frames outside a scenario remain in totals and page statistics; settings and performance_settings pages are excluded from scenario statistics
definitions.conditionChangesDuringCapture: number of changes to previously supplied theme, appearance, starfield, glassQuality, scrollCardGlassEnabled or refresh-rate values while running; initial values and device metadata readiness do not count; reset clears the count and retains current conditions
definitions.comparisonWindows: warmupFirst2Seconds is [first case FrameTiming.vsyncStart, +2 s); steadyState begins at +2 s; firstPageEntryFirst2Seconds independently covers the first observed entry of each page in this round, and may overlap warmup or steady state; spikes do not prove shader compilation
definitions.comparisonEligibility: completed; >=30 s observed case vsync span; steady frames present; one actual render condition and one refresh rate; verified renderer; variant matches actual switches; long chat >=60 messages; no condition overflow or out-of-order case timestamps
definitions.scrollCardGlassEnabled: actual scroll-card renderer; false is a static simulated-glass surface without backdrop filters or scroll background capture; true is the internal-only real-glass comparison override and requires the global glass switch; glass_on/off variants still describe the global switch, not the card renderer; raster_controls_v2 reports did not record this field

retention.pageOverflow: additional page identifiers aggregate in otherPages
